notes.title: Nightmare Frontier - Available now!
notes.content:
Hi All!!
We’re thrilled to invite you on a bold new journey: Nightmare Frontier!
This is your call to lead a posse unlike any other in gaming. Nightmare Frontier is the first-ever Tactical Extraction Looter, where your courage and cunning are tested against the Dreadweavers—living nightmares born from fear itself. Lead a crew of scavenger misfits through a shattered boomtown in an alternate 1900s. Get in. Face the horrors. Grab what you can. And most importantly—get out alive.
If that sounds like your cup of tea—or maybe something a bit stronger—we’d be honored to welcome you aboard in Nightmare Frontier.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3310950/Nightmare_Frontier/

notes.title: Rogue Waters - Set sail on 30th September.
notes.content:
Sea monsters! Pirates! Treasure! Above all, the thrill of battles for glory and revenge!
Our new game, Rogue Waters, is all that and more. Outsmart and outmaneuver even overwhelming odds. Use your crew's skills and a pirate's agility to sweep the decks of boarded ships. With our new fencing mechanic, every melee combat encounter becomes dynamic, changing the flow of battle with every strike you make. Upgrade your ship and shipmates and exact revenge from Blackbone, your former pirate captain and now the terror of the seas. Having the mighty Kraken and friends to call for aid should help even the odds somewhat.
Check out Rogue Waters, a roguelite melee tactics game from Ice Code. Wishlist, pre-order, set sail!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1691190/Rogue_Waters/

notes.title: Deep Blue Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26903194/0b3a53f428c42a1265acad6fd68f08bea043fccf.png[/img]

Hey guys, 

There are a few things we fixed and updated in the game to make your experience better! We fixed those annoying achievement bugs some of you reported, we made some minor tweaks and fixes and we added new library assets so you can enjoy looking at Deep Blue in your library!

notes.title: Re-Legion - our new cyberpunk game is coming out Q1 2019!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26903194/01ee4d8c28a4b9baae230e425b018e6f9c6fea26.png[/img]

Hey Guys, 

We have a quick announcement to make. After Deep Blue we wanted to make something bigger and better and we are almost ready to release it. 

Re-Legion is a cyberpunk RTS that let's you become a leader of your own cult. If that's something that you find interesting you can check it out and add it to your wishlist. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/782140/ReLegion/

In Re-Legion, players Follow Elion’s journey from a lone prophet to the most powerful advocate of religion in the city. Introducing a new alternative to the usual economic and resource management used in RTS games, Re-Legion allows players to convert ordinary non-believing citizens into their units – the followers. Initiated cultists then expand the cult’s possibilities by obtaining cyber-coins to enable upgrades, by praying they increase faith to gain and use special abilities, they hack buildings and ad-boards to expand and control territories, they convert other citizens or fight enemy units and non-believers.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=43-8Nk-ysC0

notes.title: Major fixes and gameplay improvement
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26903194/ab055dc6516bb8342c0ac7c74547c9abb9bbfafd.gif[/img]

Hey All! Thank you for playing! We've made some bug fixing and changes in levels in the first universe so you can upgrade much faster.

Here's a full list of changes included in this update:
- Bug fixes
- First universe design changes, you can find upgrades much faster
- Some small gameplay design changes
- Deep blue weights much less
- The minimal requirements are much smaller
- Optimization of VR
